title: Blanche Is Confirmed as Attorney General After Overcoming G.O.P. Concerns
summary: Todd Blanche, who has served as acting attorney general since April, eked out Senate approval, despite growing unease about his willingness to rein in President Trump.
body_markdown: Todd Blanche, who has served as acting attorney general since April, eked out Senate approval, despite growing unease about his willingness to rein in President Trump.
